workflows.name: Commerce and creator ads
workflows.output_zh: 商品演示、广告开场；适合电商运营、达人和小商家。
workflows.output: Product demonstrations and ad openings for sellers and creators.
workflows.reason_zh: 从一次按键或产品揭示开始，容易看清产品和动作是否稳定。
workflows.reason: Begin with one switch press or product reveal so product and action continuity are easy to inspect.
support: 生成一个过渡镜头，随后在剪辑软件拼接
Generate one transition shot; assemble it in an editor
pickup: 缺产品揭示镜头时选用
Use when a product reveal is missing
Use when a reaction shot is missing
服装广告缺布料运动镜头时选用
Use for missing fabric-motion shots in apparel ads
workflows.steps_zh: 先写一个产品动作 → 用 UGC Maker 试拍并检查 → 在同一工具完成必要镜头 → 剪辑；只在缺镜头时补拍。
workflows.steps: Write one product action → trial it in UGC Maker and inspect → make the needed shots there → edit; add another tool only for a missing shot.
workflows.inputs_zh: 产品参考和一句卖点；用图片引导时准备一致的首尾图，文字和价格后期添加。
workflows.inputs: Prepare product references and one selling point; for frame guidance supply matching start/end images. Add exact copy and prices in editing.
workflows.review_zh: 产品外观、手指接触、声音与动作、广告表述是否真实。
workflows.review: Product appearance, finger contact, sound/action alignment and truthful claims.
workflows.tags_zh: 电商 · 产品动作 · 竖屏

workflows.name: Music and release teasers
workflows.output_zh: 动态封面、音乐预告视觉；适合音乐人和封面设计师。
workflows.output: Animated cover concepts and teaser visuals for musicians and cover designers.
workflows.reason_zh: 从静态封面的小幅运动开始，再由剪辑控制音乐节奏。
workflows.reason: Start with a small movement around cover artwork; control musical timing in editing.
support: 需要不同产品或封面构图时选用
缺连接两段视觉的过渡镜头时选用
pickup: Add restrained illustrated or character motion
workflows.steps_zh: 先选自己有权使用的歌和一个视觉主题 → MusicMaker 试拍 → 检查后补同主题镜头 → 剪辑软件配歌、卡点与字幕。
workflows.steps: Choose a cleared track and one visual theme → trial in MusicMaker → inspect and add matching shots → time music and captions in an editor.
workflows.inputs_zh: 封面设计或文字场景描述，以及有权使用的音乐；不要把免费页面当作音频参考上传工具。
workflows.inputs: Prepare artwork or a written scene and a cleared track; do not assume the free page accepts audio-reference uploads.
workflows.review_zh: 封面形状、风格一致性；最终节拍、字幕和歌曲由剪辑检查。
workflows.review: Cover shape and visual consistency; verify final beat timing, captions and track in the edit.
workflows.tags_zh: 音乐 · 方形封面 · 后期配歌

workflows.name: Cinematic storyboards
workflows.output_zh: 开场、入场、运镜和转场预演；适合导演、摄影和广告分镜。
workflows.output: Opening, entrance, camera and transition studies for directors and storyboard artists.
workflows.reason_zh: 默认从 VideoWeb 的单镜头练习起步；VO4 是移动主体镜头的备选，不必两者都用。
workflows.reason: Start with the VideoWeb single-shot practice; VO4 is an alternative for a moving subject, not a required second stage.
support: 补分镜之间的过渡镜头
Generate a transition between storyboard beats
pickup: 需要跟随移动主体时选用
Use for a missing moving-subject tracking shot
workflows.steps_zh: VideoWeb 试拍一个明确起止的镜头 → 检查空间与运镜 → 同工具补必要镜头 → 剪辑排列分镜。
workflows.steps: Trial one shot with clear endpoints in VideoWeb → inspect space and camera path → add necessary shots in the same tool → arrange the storyboard in an editor.
workflows.inputs_zh: 起始构图、结束构图、主体路线；图片引导需要成对首尾图。
workflows.inputs: Define opening and ending compositions and the subject path; frame guidance needs both endpoint images.
workflows.review_zh: 门框和空间是否变形、运动方向是否一致、结尾是否能接下一镜。
workflows.review: Geometry, consistent screen direction and whether the ending can connect to the next shot.
workflows.tags_zh: 分镜 · 运镜 · 首尾帧

workflows.name: Social character stories
workflows.output_zh: 角色反应与短剧概念；适合社交账号和短片创作者。
workflows.output: Character reactions and short-drama concepts for social and short-film creators.
workflows.reason_zh: 先完成一个角色的一次反应；偏插画风格时可改用 Fylia，避免同时换人物和画风。
workflows.reason: Start with one character reaction; use Fylia as an illustrated-style alternative, avoiding simultaneous identity and style changes.
support: 需要场景连接时生成过渡镜头
pickup: 补角色使用产品的动作
workflows.steps_zh: 自己先写三句故事 → SeeVido 试拍一个反应 → 检查角色一致性 → 同工具补前后镜头 → 剪辑；产品镜头按需加入。
workflows.steps: Write a three-sentence story yourself → trial one reaction in SeeVido → check identity continuity → add adjacent shots in the same tool → edit; add product inserts only if needed.
workflows.inputs_zh: 角色外观、服装和场景描述；跨镜头沿用相同参考，不保证跨工具身份一致。
workflows.inputs: Prepare identity, wardrobe and location descriptions; reuse references across shots. Cross-tool identity consistency is not guaranteed.
workflows.review_zh: 脸、服装和手部是否变化，反应顺序是否清楚；对白另行完整听审。
workflows.review: Face, wardrobe and hands, clear reaction order, and a full listening check if dialogue is used.
workflows.tags_zh: 社交故事 · 角色反应 · 一致性

workflows.name: Teaching and presentations
workflows.output_zh: 概念插图、教学场景和提案草稿；适合教师、产品经理及培训师。
workflows.output: Concept illustrations and presentation drafts for educators and product teams.
workflows.reason_zh: 用文字描述一个可见动作，先判断它是否帮助解释概念；这里使用的是视频入口，不是文本写作服务。
workflows.reason: Describe one visible action and test whether it clarifies a concept; this route is a video entry point, not a text-writing service.
support: 需要更明确的构图时试拍另一方案
补连接讲解步骤的过渡镜头
Add a transition between explanation steps
pickup: 缺空间展示或开场镜头时选用
Add a spatial reveal or opening shot
workflows.steps_zh: 先核对知识与讲解脚本 → Chat4o 试拍单个动作 → 检查事实和画面 → 补必要镜头 → 后期添加准确图注与解说。
workflows.steps: Verify the lesson and script → trial one action in Chat4o → check factual and visual accuracy → add needed shots → add accurate labels and narration in editing.
workflows.inputs_zh: 已核实的讲解要点和场景描述；准确文字、数字和箭头后期制作。
workflows.inputs: Prepare verified teaching points and a scene description; add exact text, numbers and arrows in editing.
workflows.review_zh: 知识是否正确、动作是否容易误解；把非实拍示意标为概念演示。
workflows.review: Factual accuracy and misleading motion; label conceptual illustrations as such.
workflows.tags_zh: 教学 · 概念演示 · 事实检查

workflows.name: Visual art and architecture
workflows.output_zh: 超现实场景、建筑氛围和光影试验；适合视觉与概念设计师。
workflows.output: Surreal scenes, architectural atmosphere and lighting studies for visual designers.
workflows.reason_zh: 从一个空间里的单一光影变化开始，容易检查透视与反射。
workflows.reason: Start with one lighting change in one space so perspective and reflections can be inspected.
support: 需要插画风格时作为备选
pickup: 补连接两个空间的过渡镜头
workflows.steps_zh: SeaImagine 试拍一个空间变化 → 检查透视与反射 → 同工具补同风格镜头 → 剪辑；缺人物或移动镜头时再选备选。
workflows.steps: Trial one spatial change in SeaImagine → inspect perspective and reflections → add matching shots there → edit; use an alternative only for a missing character or moving shot.
workflows.inputs_zh: 空间描述、光线方向和保持不变的建筑结构；图片引导需成对首尾图。
workflows.inputs: Define the space, lighting direction and fixed architecture; prepare both endpoint images for frame guidance.
workflows.review_zh: 柱子和边界是否漂移、反射是否合理、超现实变化是否按意图发生。
workflows.review: Stable columns and boundaries, plausible reflections and intentional surreal changes.
workflows.tags_zh: 视觉艺术 · 建筑 · 光影
